title: QProtFuse: Query-Guided Layer Fusion for Retrieval-Augmented Protein Function Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2610.30180v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting protein functions from amino acid sequences is essential to understanding biological processes. Large language models (LLMs) offer flexible function descriptions to natural-language queries, yet their limited protein understanding motivates retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Existing protein RAG methods primarily expand external retrieval signals while overlooking the rich knowledge encoded within a single protein language model (PLM). We show that retrieval performance varies across PLM layers and biological tasks, making conventional final-layer selection suboptimal. To this end, we propose QProtFuse, which uses queries to adaptively fuse multi-layer protein features and jointly learns protein and annotation retrieval through intra-modal and cross-modal contrastive objectives. translated_title: QProtFuse：面向检索增强蛋白质功能预测的查询引导层级融合方法
translated_abstract: 从氨基酸序列预测蛋白质功能对于理解生物过程至关重要。大型语言模型（LLM）能够针对自然语言查询提供灵活的功能描述，但其对蛋白质的理解能力有限，这促使了检索增强生成（RAG）的应用。现有的蛋白质RAG方法主要侧重于扩展外部检索信号，而忽视了单个蛋白质语言模型（PLM）内部编码的丰富知识。我们证明了检索性能在PLM的不同层以及不同生物任务之间存在差异，这使得传统的最终层特征选择并非最优。为此，我们提出了QProtFuse，它利用查询自适应地融合多层蛋白质特征，并通过模态内和跨模态对比目标联合学习蛋白质检索与注释检索。在Prot-Inst-OOD数据集上，QProtFuse取得了最优的蛋白质和注释检索分数，通过注释重排达到了16.4%的Recall@1。
tldr: QProtFuse利用查询引导自适应融合蛋白质语言模型的多层特征，并通过联合对比学习实现蛋白质与注释的协同检索，显著提升检索增强式蛋白质功能预测性能。
en_tdlr: QProtFuse uses query-guided adaptive fusion of multi-layer protein language model features with joint contrastive learning to achieve state-of-the-art retrieval-augmented protein function prediction.
